_comment: Committed, athlete-free example of the freeze manifest that KQ-016 and KQ-017 require.
A real freeze lives at eval-tapes/CORPUS_FREEZE.<protocol_id>.json and stays gitignored
alongside the tapes it describes. Validate with:
The gate fails closed: a missing manifest, or one with no entries, is reported as a
RES-CORPUS blocker rather than a pass. Every entry's sha256 and bytes are checked against
the asset on disk, and no subject_key may appear in two different splits.
